title: The End Of Suffering
definition: The concept of eliminating or mitigating the root cause of suffering, ignorance, through the development of a global mind and technology.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a world where people stop feeling lonely and isolated, and instead feel connected and whole. This is what the project aims for, to help everyone end their personal suffering.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: This concept combines the philosophical insights of Buddhism with modern technology to create a system that addresses the root cause of suffering - Avidya or ignorance. It aims to make the need for spiritual enlightenment undeniable and accessible to all.
difficulty_levels.expert: The end of suffering is a philosophical and spiritual concept that has been pursued for millennia. This project represents a unique fusion of technology, philosophy, and spirituality, aiming to create a global mind and a technological system that will aid in the realization of enlightenment for all beings. It challenges traditional models of spiritual development and seeks to make the path to enlightenment more accessible and understandable to a broader audience.

extra_fields.insight: The project is a technological embodiment of the Bodhisattva Vow, aiming to help all beings achieve enlightenment before resting oneself.
